risk_scan.desc: Review the last 24 hours of changes for high-risk issues — runtime errors, data loss, permission bypasses, resource leaks, cross-platform compatibility — with locations and fixes.

doc_sync.desc: Compare the last 7 days of code, config and API changes against the docs, listing high-confidence discrepancies with file paths and update suggestions.
